aiAssist.title: AI customer assist
aiAssist.subtitle: Draft a personalised reply for your customer. LLM suggestions, medical boundary enforced.
aiAssist.contextDesc: Auto-filled if you came from a customer page
aiAssist.contextOverridePlaceholder: Add anything else the model should know about this customer…
aiAssist.guardrailsDesc: The system prompt enforces these — every time
aiAssist.guardrail1: Won't answer 'can I have surgery X?' with yes or no. Always routes to the pre-review form.
aiAssist.guardrail2: Won't invent pricing — gives indicative ranges only, prefixed 'LCM will quote for real'.
aiAssist.guardrail3: Always appends 'This is not medical advice; please contact LCM for details.' on every reply.
aiAssist.handoffDesc: If the AI is unhelpful, register the customer directly so the LCM pre-review team can take over.
aiAssist.emptyDesc: Paste the customer's story and the AI will suggest service bundles + a reply template.
aiAssist.suggestion1Prompt: My customer is a 42-year-old from the US, interested in fertility (IVF). Budget around $20k. What bundles can LCM offer and what's the indicative cost?
aiAssist.suggestion2Prompt: Customer asks: 'Can I have knee replacement surgery in China if I'm 70 and on blood thinners?' Help me draft a reply.
aiAssist.suggestion3Prompt: Write me a 100-word cold outreach DM in English for a TikTok follower interested in oncology second opinions.
aiAssist.suggestion4Prompt: Customer says: 'Is LCM legit? This sounds like a scam.' Give me a calm, evidence-based response.
aiAssist.inputPlaceholder: Describe the customer's situation or paste their message…
aiAssist.footerDisclaimer: This AI can never provide medical advice. It drafts replies only — a human KOL must review before sending to a customer.
